findings.subject: ShieldedNativePool._pay(address,uint256) (contracts/shielded/ShieldedNativePool.sol#39-42) sends eth to arbitrary user
findings.reason: This is the native pool's intended withdrawal payment. unshield binds this exact recipient and amount in its verified public inputs, rejects zero/self recipients, spends nullifiers and reduces totalShielded before calling _pay, and protects the whole entry point with nonReentrant. An arbitrary caller cannot choose another proof's destination.

findings.subject: AdultAgeGate._timestampToDate(uint256) (contracts/family/AdultAgeGate.sol#37-55) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
findings.reason: The Gregorian date conversion intentionally uses integer quotients to extract calendar cycles, years, months and days. The discarded remainder is handled by the subsequent subtraction in this exact algorithm. Reordering multiplication and division would change calendar boundaries rather than improve monetary precision; this calculation does not handle asset balances.

findings.subject: IdentityAuthorizationState.incrementCounter(uint256,uint256,uint64,uint64,bytes) (contracts/receive/IdentityAuthorizationState.sol#135-186) uses a dangerous strict equality:
findings.reason: The comparison checks whether a deterministic Merkle update left the root unchanged and rejects that impossible/no-op transition. It does not compare an externally movable currency balance or timestamp; unrelated transfers cannot alter either locally computed root.

findings.subject: IdentityAuthorizationState.getCounterProof(uint256) (contracts/receive/IdentityAuthorizationState.sol#103-126) uses a dangerous strict equality:
findings.reason: Counter zero is the dictionary's intentional absence sentinel. Stored authorization counters start at one and increment exactly; checking equality with zero produces the canonical non-membership flag. This value is not an attacker-inflatable currency balance.
